wand.label: Explain simply
payments.confirming: Confirming with PayPal. Check back in a moment.
payments.complete: Payment sent to the seller account (demo record).
status.suspiciousTextFound: Suspicious text found in the file
simple.paymentReserved.whatHappened: The buyer has put the money in a safe box. It is not yours yet, but it is not going anywhere.
simple.paymentReserved.whatItMeans: Show us your lab report and the first part opens.
simple.checkingReport.whatHappened: Your lab report is like a school report card for your spice.
simple.checkingReport.whatItMeans: We read the numbers and match them with what the buyer asked for.
simple.checkingReport.whatToDo: Wait for the check to finish.
simple.couldNotConfirm.whatHappened: We could not read it well, or a number did not match.
simple.couldNotConfirm.whatToDo: Send a clearer photo or file and we will look again.
simple.firstPaymentPaid.whatHappened: The first part of the money is now paid to you.
simple.firstPaymentPaid.whatItMeans: Pack the goods and ship them. The rest comes when the buyer receives them.
simple.finalPaymentPaid.whatHappened: The last part of the money has arrived.
simple.finalPaymentPaid.whatItMeans: The order is finished. Well done!
simple.problemReported.whatHappened: The buyer says the goods are not what was promised.
simple.problemReported.whatItMeans: A fair person will look at papers and photos from both of you. You can add your own papers too.
simple.problemReported.whatToDo: Add your counter-evidence if you have any.
simple.moneyReturned.whatHappened: The papers showed the goods did not match, so the first part goes back to the buyer.
simple.moneyReturned.whatItMeans: Money already paid to you will be taken from your next payments.
simple.shipped.whatItMeans: They are on the way to the buyer.
simple.delivered.whatHappened: The buyer has received the goods.
simple.delivered.whatItMeans: The final payment will be paid soon.
simple.reservationExpiring.whatHappened: The money reservation is ending soon.
simple.reservationExpiring.whatItMeans: If it ends, the money goes back to the buyer.
simple.reservationExpiring.whatToDo: Ask the buyer to renew it.
simple.buyerCheckingReport.whatHappened: The buyer is looking at your lab report.
simple.buyerCheckingReport.whatItMeans: They decide if it matches what they asked for.
simple.labReportPassed.whatHappened: Your lab report passed the quality check.
simple.labReportPassed.whatItMeans: The first payment is now ready.
simple.labReportPassed.whatToDo: The payment will be sent automatically.
simple.awaitingApproval.whatHappened: The buyer is checking your lab report.
simple.awaitingApproval.whatItMeans: They will approve or ask for a better copy.
simple.renewReservation.whatHappened: The money reservation needs to be renewed.
simple.renewReservation.whatItMeans: The buyer needs to approve a new reservation.
simple.renewReservation.whatToDo: Ask the buyer to approve the renewal.
simple.confirmingWithPayPal.whatHappened: We are checking with PayPal to make sure the payment went through.
simple.confirmingWithPayPal.whatItMeans: This usually takes a few seconds.
simple.suspiciousTextFound.whatHappened: The file has some text that looks like instructions.
simple.suspiciousTextFound.whatToDo: Upload a clean file without extra text.
simple.reservationCancelled.whatItMeans: The money stays with the buyer.
simple.reservationCancelled.whatToDo: Start a new order if needed.
